items.title: Self-Reports Are Not Verification: Environment-Grounded Auditing of LLM Operators in Evolutionary Search
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.00652v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Language model agents increasingly propose actions, observe external feedback, and explain their own behavior. Their confidence and rationales are convenient monitoring signals, but convenience is not verification. We introduce an environment-grounded audit in which every intermediate proposal receives an exact outcome. A language model operates an evolutionary Contexto search whose feedback function assigns every valid guess an exact rank without human annotation. Across 200 runs spanning five configurations and three model families, four reporting configurations produce 12,249 self-reports. We test three assumptions: stated confidence is calibrated, inherited rationales affect later proposals, and fitness-based selection improves report quality. All three fail. items.title: [Agent 考古] 意图编辑权：从 BDI 到 LLM Agent，谁有权决定机器何时停下来
items.raw_text:
决定 Agent 做什么、何时坚持、何时放弃的权力，究竟归谁？本文综合全系列给出观点：McCarthy 时代编辑权在设计者手里，C&L 与 R&G 把它部分移交给数据结构，LLM 时代被系统提示词与工具白名单整体没收。三时空同构显示，1990 年的形式化、1995 年的工程、2026 年的实证在追问同一个问题。自止焊接节把 PGOAL 放弃条件接到“自知、自觉、自止”三问：最后的编辑权叫自止，而自止至今无主。

Source
items.reason_zh: 深度探讨Agent意图编辑权演变，从BDI到LLM，思想深刻，启发性强。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了Agent系统中意图编辑权的归属问题，从McCarthy时代的设计者控制，到C&L与R&G的数据结构转移，再到LLM时代被系统提示词和工具白名单没收。作者通过三时空同构分析，指出1990年的形式化、1995年的工程和2026年的实证都在追问同一个问题：谁有权决定机器何时停止。文章提出“自止”概念，认为最后的编辑权应属于Agent自身，但目前尚无归属。

items.title: The Privacy-Hallucination Tradeoff in Differentially Private Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.00492v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Both privacy and factual accuracy are paramount in high-stakes domains like healthcare. Concerningly, we uncover and investigate a privacy-hallucination tradeoff in differentially private (DP) language models. First, we empirically show that models pre-trained or fine-tuned with DP tend to produce more hallucinations than non-DP counterparts, with increased severity as the privacy budget grows stricter. Second, we investigate model properties driving this tradeoff, demonstrating that DP mechanisms flatten output distributions, potentially redistributing probability mass toward factually incorrect alternatives. Third, through experiments where we control fact frequency in training data, we characterize how information frequency can reduce hallucination risks in DP models. Overall, our findings underscore the need for more nuanced privacy-preserving interventions that offer rigorous privacy guarantees without compromising factual accuracy.

items.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.00355v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, yet on vision-language models (VLMs) it has been caught in a self-defeating cycle. The drafter stays autoregressive, so it must stay small. A small drafter cannot afford the image at every step, so vision is compressed, pruned, or hidden. A drafter cut off from the image is then least reliable exactly where the image makes text predictable. We present GLANCE, the first one-pass block drafter that is lossless on an unmodified VLM target, and it breaks the cycle at both ends. A block-diffusion head reads the target's already-fused vision-language state, so vision costs the drafter nothing, and fills a whole block in one forward pass, so depth costs no sequential steps. A wide candidate tree is verified in one target pass, and every audited prompt reproduces greedy decoding exactly. items.summary_zh: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中投机解码的困境，提出“单遍块草稿”方法。传统草稿模型因自回归而必须保持小规模，导致无法每步处理图像，造成视觉信息压缩或丢失。新方法通过一次性草稿多个块，使草稿模型能够充分利用图像信息，同时保持无损加速。实验表明，该方法在多个VLM基准上显著提升解码速度，且不改变输出分布。

items.title: AI Efficiency Could Cost Us the Next Generation of Experts
items.raw_text:
A little over a decade ago, I led the controls design for a first-of-its-kind full digital-control system for a U.S. nuclear plant. It was, on paper, a beautiful machine—engineered to run itself the way a modern airliner does, with operators watching over a system that rarely needed them. And we made a decision that, to an efficiency-minded observer, looked backward: We deliberately left manual steps inside sequences the system could execute on its own.

We were solving a specific problem. An operator who only ever supervises automation slowly stops being an operator. The hands go cold. The mental model of what the plant is actually doing gets fuzzy. Then comes the day the automation hands control back.

items.title: dsh 也能进 Discord 了：我给 DeepSeek Harness 写了个适配器
items.raw_text:
TL;DR

dsh-discord：给 DeepSeek Harness 写的 Discord 适配器。@机器人下任务，thread 即开，审批按钮直接送到手机。

为什么自己动手写一个

上回那篇《从聊天窗口到工作台：这半年，我的 Agent 工作流换了一代》里说过，我的 Agent 工作台已经统一到了 Discord：云上的 Hermes 原生支持 Discord，本地的 OpenCode 通过 Kimaki 接入，一个 thread 一个任务，thread 就是 session 的边界。

缺的一块是 dsh。DeepSeek Harness 是我最近用下来很顺手的 harness agent，尤其是插件系统——不用 fork，不用改源码，一个插件挂进 profile 就能扩展它的能力面，这是我最喜欢的样子。但官方入口只有 Web 页面，试过几个社区做的 Discord 插件，要么把整个会话糊在单频道里，要么 thread 状态管理形同虚设——Discord 最有价值的 channel 和 thread 结构，在这几个插件里基本没有被当成一回事。
items.reason_zh: 作者为DeepSeek Harness编写Discord适配器，分享实践，对Agent工作流爱好者有参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 作者分享了为DeepSeek Harness（dsh）编写Discord适配器的过程。通过该适配器，用户可以在Discord中直接与dsh交互，实现任务下发、审批等功能。文章详细介绍了实现思路和代码，并提供了使用场景，对于希望将Agent接入聊天平台的开发者具有实用价值。

items.title: I made an Automated Academic AI researcher which is hallucination proof.
items.raw_text:
A while back I released Automated-AI-Web-Researcher-Ollama, which turned a local model into an automated researcher that searched the web, scraped sites, and compiled findings on its own. It got a much better reception than I expected.

But it had a problem I couldn't get past: the web is full of confident nonsense, and an LLM summarising confident nonsense produces confident nonsense with citations attached.

So I built the successor. It doesn't search the web at all — it goes to the actual scientific literature.

👉 https://github.com/TheBlewish/Academic-AI-Literature-Reviewer-Ollama
